# Zain Ul Abdin

> Growth marketing specialist for SaaS and service businesses. SEO, Reddit marketing, social media management, Google and Meta ads, and content and design, all planned and executed by one person instead of a team of specialists.

Zain Ul Abdin is a growth marketing specialist based in Lahore, Pakistan, working with SaaS, AI, technology, home services and ecommerce companies across the US, UAE and Europe. His approach: diagnose the single constraint actually blocking growth before recommending any tactic, then execute the fix himself rather than handing off a strategy deck. Selected results include taking Blainy from 0 to 85,000+ users with no paid acquisition (~30M search impressions, 3.9M+ Instagram views), and driving 160,000+ Facebook views in 28 days for Everdry Waterproofing.

## Services

- [All services](https://www.zainameen.com/services): Overview of all six growth marketing services for SaaS and service businesses, with where to start if you're not sure which one you need.
- [Growth strategy and GTM](https://www.zainameen.com/services/saas-growth-consultant): Growth audits and go-to-market planning that find the real bottleneck across positioning, offer, acquisition, conversion, activation and retention before recommending anything. Audits from $499; ongoing execution from $3,999/month.
- [SEO](https://www.zainameen.com/services/seo-specialist-for-saas): Search strategy, technical SEO, content and on-page work, authority building, and AI search visibility (GEO) for ChatGPT/AI Overviews. $1,999/month.
- [Reddit marketing](https://www.zainameen.com/services/reddit-marketing-specialist): Organic Reddit community marketing: research, real accounts, useful posts and threads that keep surfacing in Google and AI answers, without paid ads. $1,199/month.
- [Social media management](https://www.zainameen.com/services/social-media-marketing-specialist): Strategy, content, creative and community distribution across social platforms. From $1,199/month.
- [Google and Meta ads](https://www.zainameen.com/services/google-and-meta-ads-specialist): Paid acquisition management with tracking fixed first and landing pages optimized before spend scales. $1,499/month.
- [Content and design](https://www.zainameen.com/services): Articles, landing page copy, social content and graphics made as one system. Described on the services page; there's no separate page yet, so projects are scoped through the contact page.
